segments.text: A friendly girl who refers to herself using the self-pronoun 'Boku'. She is a clumsy girl who always finds herself making mistakes, and needing someone else to look after her. She loathes the feeling of loneliness, and enjoys basking in the warmth of others. Her friendly nature results from her fear of being left alone. She possesses a sharp mind, having the capability to make sharp deductions and reasonings, with excellent observational skills. However, she deliberately makes mistakes, out of a fear of being disliked otherwise. However, when it comes to helping someone else, she shows extraordinary deductive skills. She possesses a strong will to never give up, continuing to endure, no matter what the situation may bring.
Extended profiles are from the Official Site.

Excellent academics, well-rounded athletics, and a disguinshed family — a flawless girl in every sense of the world, a "Yamato Nadeshiko". Trusted by all those around her, she held a prominent position in school as well. She has a strong sense of responsibility, something that she takes upon herself with honor. She has a strong value system, consisting of a right sense of 'right' and 'wrong'. This can lead her to a rather close-minded way of thinking. She wishes to see a pure world, untainted by evil. She has a more delicate side to her as well, being rather sentimental with those she holds close to her heart. It seems that she and Ema had some sort of connection in the past.
Extended profiles are from the Official Site.

A recluse who struggles with communication. Certain circumstances have rendered her unable to speak, spending her days without uttering a word to anyone. She prefers to keep to herself, and stays indoors all day, playing games. She has a remarkably low standard for self-praise, praising herself for even the smallest of efforts such as brushing her teeth. She dislikes exerting any effort, and avoids pushing herself beyond what's necessary. She hardly ever speaks, and instead communicates through writing. On the rare occasion that she does communicate with others, she uses an exaggerated and magniloquent manner of speech, reminiscent to that of a grand writer.
Original Sin: Sleeping Beauty of Deceit.
Extended profiles are from the Official Site.

An anonymous street artist, making waves across the globe. Despite her art being adored worldwide, nobody knows anything of her true identity. She speaks with little regard to anyone, always drawing out her words in curiosity. She works at her own pace, and can be rather elusive. She is incredibly curious, always questioning everything, and asking strange questions from people without a second thought. Her ideal painting is that which can depict her own happiness, but it seems that this is a painting that she can never complete.
Extended profiles are from the Official Site.

A young girl who aspires to become a star actress, and currently works as the top performer of a theatre troupe. She has a gentlemanly demeanor, and speaks in a theatrical manner. She always takes on a leader-like position in groups, doing her best to keep everyone in line. Although her words may come across as arrogant, she is willing to give up her life if it were for the sake of protecting another person. She finds it difficult to rely on others, often causing her to shoulder pressure by herself. Although hardworking, she doesn't particularly enjoy the work in of itself. When she gets a chance to relax, she likes to watch cat videos to feel better.
Original Sin: Idol of the Stage.
Extended profiles are from the Official Site.

A girl whose style of dressing resembles that of the Shiro Gyaru subculture. Despite her cute way of dressing, she always speaks in a melancholic way, and prefers to spend her time watching old movies. She is well aware of the appeal she carries as a beautiful young girl, but contrary to her bold appearance, she happens to have a quiet and mellow personality. Although she can be rather clumsy. she is incredibly kind at heart, and always cares for those around her. While she isn't particularly averse to communicating with others, she prefers not to speak much of herself. All of her words happen to carry a dark undertone.
Extended profiles are from the Official Site.

A con artist with a friendly demeanor, greeting everyone with a smile. A smooth talker with exceedingly sharp observation skills, and a keen eye for detail, quick on her feet. Despite being a mere 15-year old girl, she is a highly skilled con-artist, making a living through her fraudulent activities. She has no qualms about engaging in any and all manners of fraud, and is not above posing as an adult to employ seductive tactics as well. She has a mind set to 'never trust, never believe' and has no faith in the world—including, but not limited to people, objects, and even natural phenomena. She seems to not have a care in the world, always teasing others, dominating any conversation in which she partakes. Neither her smile nor her words are ever sincere.
Original Sin: A Person who Knows Love.
Extended profiles are from the Official Site.

A girl who harbors intense hatred for the prison. She always presents a cold-hearted disposition, behaving in a way that pushes others away. She refuses to let herself be bound by emotion, stoically pursuing her mission, regardless of the means. She seems to already know all there is about the prison, showing a strange familiarity with its rules, history, and structure. She refuses to let herself form connections with those around her, and hates being a burden above all else. She prefers to act alone, instead, and often goes missing. This cold-hearted exterior of hers was not always part of her personality, and is not true to who she really is.
Original Sin: Soldier from the Past.
Extended profiles are from the Official Site.

A run-away delinquent, always spilling harsh words and profanities, and always quick to fight. She dropped out of school two years ago, and has never had a single friend. She always stay out in the city streets, hanging around late at night, preferring the gritty underground feel that it carries. She swears that she commits no crime beyond fighting, and is completely honest in her words. She hates herself more than anything else, and vows to destroy all that she hates. However, a part of her still wishes to find someone who can accept her flawed self, and longs for a sincere relationship. She can easily be swayed by those who are kind.
Extended profiles are from the Official Site.

An ever-cheeeful girl who can always be seen with a smile on her face, who always speaks politely. She has a carefree and whimsical air to her, and so earned the derogatory nickname of 'fairy' at her school. She claims to be a great detective, and is completely obsessed with mystery novels, loving to make deductions. She once saved her classmate by exposing their bullies, and has since believed detective work to be her calling. She always happens to be curious about things, and pursues that which she finds interesting to the bitter end, never letting go, regardless of what others may think. She's often unable to read the room, and has absolutely no sense of morality.
Extended profiles are from the Official Site.

An enigmatic young girl who speaks in a refined yet unconventional manner, often trying to supplement her speech with flowery words, imitating the manner of a rich young lady. It is unknown as to why she does so. She is incredibly slim and short, reminiscent of a bisque doll. She tends to act condescending, and tries to feign nobility. She claims to be the daughter of a rich, distinguished family, but her words and actions point towards the contrary. She often speaks in an arrogant manner, and is quick to argue when someone points out the contradictions in her words. Despite this, she is ultimately good-natured at heart, and glimpses of her kindness can be seen in her interactions with those whom she holds close to her.
Extended profiles are from the Official Site.

A streamer girl, she earns a little on the side from 'Let's Play' streams and idle chatter. Strongly opinionated, she always held the center of attention in her class. Though she always smiles in her streams, in reality, she's actually quite the two-faced person. She always spews harsh words and aggressive remarks during her time in prison, and makes her desire to go home loud and clear. She shrewdly sides with those whom she believe will give her the upper-hand. The only times at which she truly seems happy are when she talks about her 'oshi', being giddy like a school-girl experiencing her first love
Extended profiles are from the Official Site.

A bundle of anxiety who always worries for others. She has a stalker-like disposition, obsessively following those who have caught her attention. If one is to sense the presence of someone lurking nearby, chances are that it happens to be Meruru, hiding in the shadows. She always happens to be on the verge of tears, and cries over the smallest of matters. She always finds herself worrying over whether may come across as strange to others, or if she may have done something to hurt anyone. She has an excessively negative view of herself, and wallows in self-hatred. Conversely, she views others with great admiration. She prefers to spend her time by her lonesome, reading books in order to relax herself.
Extended profiles are from the Official Site.
The warden of the prison. A mysterious owl who manages the trial, the prisoners, and the entire house.
